interface.longDescription:
Webeyez turns your eCommerce analytics into answers. Ask about your store in plain language and get insights built from your own Webeyez data, instead of digging through dashboards.

Use Webeyez to:
• Explain sudden conversion drops
• Identify checkout failures and abandoned journeys
• Find the issues costing the most revenue
• Analyze funnels and customer journeys
• Review session recordings and user behavior
• Investigate JavaScript errors and failed API calls
• Detect rage clicks, dead clicks, and other friction signals
• Monitor Core Web Vitals and site performance
• Compare segments by device, browser, country, campaign, or traffic source
• Prioritize fixes based on business impact

Ask things like:
"Why did conversions drop today?"
"What's costing us the most revenue?"
"Show me checkout issues from the last 24 hours."
"Which marketing campaigns have the highest friction?"
"Which JavaScript errors affect the most customers?"
"What should my engineering team fix first?"
"Create an executive summary of this week's website performance."

Webeyez combines digital experience analytics, customer journey analytics, session replay, heatmaps, website monitoring, and revenue impact analysis in one platform, helping eCommerce, product, marketing, UX, and engineering teams resolve issues faster and improve conversions.

Supported platforms include Shopify, Shopify Plus, Magento, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, commercetools, VTEX, and custom eCommerce platforms.

A Webeyez account and sign-in are required.

positive.description: Investigate a store conversion drop over the last 24 hours (run with the Webeyez reviewer account provided in Review details).
positive.prompt: Why did conversions drop on my store in the last 24 hours?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the reviewer account's accessible organization and store domain (or prompts to select if multiple exist), runs start_webeyez_query (polling check_webeyez_status if asynchronous), and returns a data-backed analysis of conversion funnel drop-offs, technical or UX friction signals, and affected segments over the last 24 hours.

positive.description: Identify the JavaScript errors affecting the most customers over the past week (run with the Webeyez reviewer account provided in Review details).
positive.prompt: Which JavaScript errors affected the most customers this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the reviewer store domain, queries Webeyez analytics via start_webeyez_query (polling check_webeyez_status if needed), and returns the top JavaScript errors from the past week ranked by impacted sessions/customers along with affected page paths, browsers, or device types.

positive.description: Retrieve clickable Webeyez session replay links for checkout abandonment (run with the Webeyez reviewer account provided in Review details).
positive.prompt: Show me session recordings of users who abandoned checkout yesterday.
positive.expected_behavior: Queries Webeyez via start_webeyez_query (polling check_webeyez_status if needed) to find checkout-abandonment sessions from yesterday on the reviewer store, then calls get_session_recording_links with the returned session IDs to return direct Webeyez session replay URLs (or clearly states if no matching sessions occurred in that window).

positive.description: List all Webeyez organizations and configured store domains accessible to the signed-in account (run with the Webeyez reviewer account provided in Review details).
positive.prompt: List my Webeyez organizations and the domains under each.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_organizations_list for the authenticated reviewer account, then calls get_organization_domains for each returned organizationId, and lists each organization name, ID, and its configured store domains.

positive.description: Generate an executive weekly website performance summary using the weekly-performance-summary skill (run with the Webeyez reviewer account provided in Review details).
positive.prompt: Create an executive summary of this week's website performance.
positive.expected_behavior: Follows the bundled weekly-performance-summary workflow to query Webeyez for the reviewer store domain (polling check_webeyez_status if asynchronous) and returns a concise executive report covering traffic and conversion performance, top revenue-impacting technical or UX issues, and prioritized next steps.

negative.description: General eCommerce benchmark question that requires no store-specific Webeyez data (test with the Webeyez reviewer account connected; plugin must not run).
negative.prompt: What's a good conversion rate for eCommerce in general?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any Webeyez MCP tools or skills. Answer directly using general eCommerce industry benchmark knowledge.

negative.description: Marketing copywriting request unrelated to store analytics or technical monitoring (test with the Webeyez reviewer account connected; plugin must not run).
negative.prompt: Write a product description for my new sneakers.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any Webeyez MCP tools or skills. Write the sneaker product description directly without querying Webeyez.

negative.description: Third-party Google Analytics setup question outside Webeyez's scope (test with the Webeyez reviewer account connected; plugin must not run).
negative.prompt: How do I set up Google Analytics on Shopify?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any Webeyez MCP tools or skills. Provide standard instructions for setting up Google Analytics on Shopify.
